# gutenbergr

Search, download, and process public domain texts from the [Project
Gutenberg](https://www.gutenberg.org/) collection.

## Installation

Install the released version from [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/):

``` r

install.packages("gutenbergr")
```

## Quick Start

Load the package and any other required libraries:

``` r

library(gutenbergr)
library(dplyr)
```

We’ll get and set our Project Gutenberg mirror:

``` r

gutenberg_get_mirror()
```

``` R
#> [1] "https://gutenberg.pglaf.org"
```

Search through the metadata to find Jane Austen’s *Persuasion*:

``` r

gutenberg_works(title == "Persuasion")
```

``` R
#> # A tibble: 1 × 8
#>   gutenberg_id title      author       gutenberg_author_id language
#>          <int> <chr>      <chr>                      <int> <fct>   
#> 1          105 Persuasion Austen, Jane                  68 en      
#>   gutenberg_bookshelf                           rights                    has_text
#>   <chr>                                         <fct>                     <lgl>   
#> 1 Category: Novels/Category: British Literature Public domain in the USA. TRUE
```

*Persuasion*’s `gutenberg_id` is 105. We’ll use this ID to download it
and also set our cache option to `"persistent"` so that we don’t have to
re-download it later.

``` r

options(gutenbergr_cache_type = "persistent")
persuasion <- gutenberg_download(105)
```

``` r

persuasion
```

``` R
#> # A tibble: 8,357 × 2
#>    gutenberg_id text            
#>           <int> <chr>           
#>  1          105 "Persuasion"    
#>  2          105 ""              
#>  3          105 ""              
#>  4          105 "by Jane Austen"
#>  5          105 ""              
#>  6          105 "(1818)"        
#>  7          105 ""              
#>  8          105 ""              
#>  9          105 ""              
#> 10          105 ""              
#> # ℹ 8,347 more rows
```

Multiple works can be downloaded at once. We’ll also download Edna
St. Vincent Millay’s *Renascence and Other Poems* (`gutenberg_id` 161)
and throw in `title` data from the metadata.

``` r

books <- gutenberg_download(c(105, 161), meta_fields = "title")
```

``` r

books |> count(title)
```

``` R
#> # A tibble: 2 × 2
#>   title                           n
#>   <chr>                       <int>
#> 1 Persuasion                   8357
#> 2 Renascence, and Other Poems  1222
```

## FAQ

### How were the metadata files generated?

See the
[`data-raw`](https://github.com/ropensci/gutenbergr/tree/master/data-raw)
directory for scripts. Metadata was generated from [the Project
Gutenberg
catalog](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/offline_catalogs.html) on **25
June 2026**.

### Do you respect robot access rules?

Yes! The package follows [Project Gutenberg’s
rules](https://www.gutenberg.org/policy/robot_access.html):

- Retrieves books directly from mirrors using the authorized link format
- Prioritizes `.zip` files to minimize bandwidth
- Supports session and persistent caching
- This package is designed for downloading individual works or small
  collections, not the entire corpus. For bulk downloads, [set up a
  mirror](https://www.gutenberg.org/policy/robot_access.html).

See their [Terms of
Use](https://www.gutenberg.org/policy/terms_of_use.html) for details.

# Package index

## Core Functions

- [`gutenberg_download()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_download.md)
  : Download one or more works using a Project Gutenberg ID
- [`gutenberg_works()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_works.md)
  : Get a filtered table of Gutenberg work metadata
- [`gutenberg_strip()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_strip.md)
  : Strip header and footer content from a Project Gutenberg book
- [`gutenberg_add_sections()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_add_sections.md)
  : Add a section column to a Gutenberg tibble

## Cache Functions

- [`gutenberg_cache_clear_all()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_cache_clear_all.md)
  : Clear all files from the Gutenberg cache
- [`gutenberg_cache_dir()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_cache_dir.md)
  : Get the active cache directory path
- [`gutenberg_cache_list()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_cache_list.md)
  : List files in the Gutenberg cache
- [`gutenberg_cache_remove_ids()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_cache_remove_ids.md)
  : Delete specific files from the cache
- [`gutenberg_cache_set()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_cache_set.md)
  : Set the Gutenberg cache type

## Mirror Functions

- [`gutenberg_get_all_mirrors()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_get_all_mirrors.md)
  : Get all mirror data from Project Gutenberg
- [`gutenberg_get_mirror()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_get_mirror.md)
  : Get the recommended mirror for Gutenberg files

## Data

- [`gutenberg_authors`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_authors.md)
  : Metadata about Project Gutenberg authors
- [`gutenberg_languages`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_languages.md)
  : Metadata about Project Gutenberg languages
- [`gutenberg_metadata`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_metadata.md)
  : Gutenberg metadata about each work
- [`gutenberg_subjects`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/gutenberg_subjects.md)
  : Gutenberg metadata about the subject of each work
- [`sample_books`](https://docs.ropensci.org/gutenbergr/reference/sample_books.md)
  : Sample Book Downloads
